self-audit found G1/G2/G3 were one common phenotype palette with different price maps, not disjoint program/state-model implementations

grammar_native_engine.implementation_disjointness: Each grammar has a separate token prefix/inventory, program serialization and primitive cost algebra; pairwise token intersection is asserted empty at import time.
grammar_native_engine.candidate_generation: Each grammar exhaustively crosses 22 neutral resource/state shapes with routing, sharing, retrieval, serve-iteration, stochasticity, verification, authority, update-locality and width choices, subject only to target-independent coherence checks.
grammar_native_engine.property_measurement: The ten K4 axes are measured from the generated program phenotype. The frozen target property vector is removed before ranking and used only after the winner is frozen.
grammar_native_engine.control_gate: CTL_IDENTITY, CTL_CONSTANT, CTL_LOOKUP and CTL_AFFINE are recovered inside each grammar-native candidate space before a scientific verdict is allowed.
grammar_native_engine.coverage: The registered 1e6 budget must exhaust each finite candidate space; otherwise the cell is INCONCLUSIVE_SEARCH.

public_beacon_rule.network: League of Entropy drand quicknet mainnet
public_beacon_rule.selection: Use exactly the first quicknet round whose round timestamp is at least 900 seconds after the GitHub committed_at timestamp of THIS V3 freeze commit.

protected_rule: No V3 protected task may execute until the one-shot V3 public beacon receipt exists. Development smoke/probe seeds are excluded from the V3 aggregate.
claim_ceiling: V3 can provide protected same-author grammar-native K4 evidence at this finite registered scope. It still cannot self-close external primitive-selection or meter-bucketing independence, K5 held-family prediction, real-workload transfer, or physical frontier evidence.
